# EMUSKI Manufacturing Solutions
> ISO 9001:2015 certified OEM precision manufacturing and cost engineering partner in Bangalore, India. Combining 15+ years of manufacturing excellence with AI-powered optimization to serve global OEMs in automotive, aerospace, medical device, and electronics industries.

## Company Identity
- **Company Name**: EMUSKI Manufacturing Solutions
- **Founded**: 2008 (Mithran AI platform launched 2022)
- **Business Type**: ISO Certified OEM Precision Manufacturing & Cost Engineering Company
- **Headquarters**: 126 RNS Plaza, Electronic City Phase 2, Bangalore, Karnataka 560100, India
- **Manufacturing Facility**: Hosur, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Website**: https://www.emuski.com
- **Phone**: +91-86670-88060
- **Email**: enquiries@emuski.com
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, FDA Manufacturing Compliance

## Core Business Description
EMUSKI is an engineering, manufacturing, and AI innovation company based in Bangalore, India, that helps OEMs design and produce components faster using AI-driven tools and rapid prototyping. Specializing in precision manufacturing services and cost engineering (VAVE), EMUSKI provides end-to-end solutions including CNC machining, injection molding, and cost engineering aimed at enhancing profitability and reducing time-to-market across automotive, aerospace, and electronics industries.

## Primary Services & Capabilities

### AI-Powered Engineering Solutions
- **Mithran AI Platform**: AI-driven cost estimation providing rapid cost breakdowns and "should-cost" modeling
- AI-powered VAVE (Value Analysis Value Engineering) methodology
- Automated design for manufacturing (DFM) analysis
- Predictive quality analytics and optimization
- Smart manufacturing process optimization

### Precision Manufacturing Services
- **CNC Machining**: 3-axis, 4-axis, 5-axis VMC precision machining
- **Rapid Prototyping**: 3D printing (SLA, SLS, FDM), vacuum casting
- **Injection Molding**: Low-volume and high-volume plastic injection molding
- **Casting**: Investment casting and sand casting services
- **Sheet Metal Fabrication**: Precision sheet metal components
- **Assembly Services**: Complete product assembly and testing
- **Quality Control**: CMM inspection, 3D scanning, dimensional analysis

### Cost Engineering & Optimization
- **VAVE Analysis**: Achieving 25–35% cost reductions for clients
- **Should-Cost Modeling**: AI-driven cost estimation and validation
- **Strategic Sourcing**: Global supplier identification and management
- **Product Teardown Analysis**: Competitive cost benchmarking
- **Design Optimization**: Cost-effective design recommendations
- **Supply Chain Optimization**: End-to-end cost reduction strategies

## Target Industries & Specializations
- **Automotive**: EV manufacturing, traditional automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers
- **Aerospace**: Aircraft components, defense systems, space technology
- **Medical Devices**: FDA-compliant manufacturing, surgical instruments, diagnostics
- **Electronics**: Semiconductor packaging, consumer electronics, industrial equipment
- **Defense**: Military-spec components, tactical equipment, aerospace defense
